mask_policy.operation: EXIF transpose RGB photo; grayscale JPEG mask to uint8 PNG, foreground=255 for values >=128; no resizing or morphology
mask_policy.status: project_preprocessing_decision; evaluate threshold sensitivity before qualification

pair_policy.action: keep candidate groups together and select lowest source ID as representative; never delete originals
pair_policy.review: compare all candidate pairs after indicated transform at native resolution, including binary masks
